en.sayed-ali-raza: I do long that Allāh may cause separation between me and you
and give me those who have a better right to be with me than you.
By Allāh, they are people of blissful ideas, enduring wisdom and true speech. They keep aloof from revolt.
They trod forward on the path (of Allāh) and ran on the high-road.
Consequently, they achieved the everlasting next life and easeful honours.
